text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kinko Sho. Seeking the Pearl, my dorm roommate, also appears to be worried about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I have to work harder to be less immature… I need to become a considerate Umamusume who won't hurt anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure… that's the way a princess ought to be…
